section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Control and ownership for AML compliance

cards.title: 审查所有权结构时识别最终受益所有人 (UBO)

flow_nodes.label: 审查所有权结构 (when reviewing ownership structures)
机构识别客户的最终受益所有人 (UBO) (regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer)
客户的 UBO 被识别

flow_edges.source_quote: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.
regulatory obligation to identify the UBO

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：审查所有权结构事件（E1）→（PRECEDES）机构识别客户的 UBO（P1）→（PRODUCES）UBO 被识别（X1）。基础 KG 不足以表达该条件触发义务的局部有向关系；选项判断价值：可确认在审查所有权结构时需识别 UBO，排除仅在特定情况下识别等干扰项。LLM推理：无。

cards.title: 无自然人受益所有人时识别控制人或名义受益所有人

flow_nodes.label: 公司中不存在自然人受益所有人 (in companies where there is no natural beneficial owner)
机构识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人 (a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified)
控制人或名义受益所有人被识别，以了解谁控制公司决策 (understand who is in control of the decision-making)

flow_edges.condition: 当公司中没有自然人受益所有人时
flow_edges.source_quote: In companies where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified.
This allows you to understand who is in control of the decision-making in the company when natural individual UBOs are not present.

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：当不存在自然人受益所有人时（E1）→（PRECEDES）识别并核实控制人（P1）→（PRODUCES）控制人被识别以了解决策控制（X1）。基础 KG 不足以表达这一例外情形的完整有向处置链；选项判断价值：可确认在无自然人 UBO 时的替代识别义务及目的。LLM推理：无。
